ja: 私たちの予約の日付が間違っているようなので、確認していただけないかと思いまして。
en: It seems there's a mistake with the dates on our booking, so I was wondering if you could check it.
alternatives: There seems to be an error in the dates of our reservation, so I was wondering if you could look into it.
It looks like the dates on our booking are wrong, so I was wondering if you could check them.
point: 丁寧な依頼は I was wondering if you could と過去形で

ja: 私たち、空港行きのバスに乗り遅れてしまいました。次のバスは何時ですか？
en: We missed the airport bus. When's the next one?
alternatives: We missed the bus to the airport. What time is the next one?
We've missed the airport bus. When does the next one come?
point: 「乗り遅れる」は miss。過去形 missed で言う

ja: なくなったスーツケースに名札を付けておけばよかったって、妻がずっと言っています。
en: My wife keeps saying she wishes she had put a name tag on the suitcase that went missing.
alternatives: My wife keeps saying she wishes she'd attached a name tag to the missing suitcase.
My wife keeps telling me she wishes she had put a name tag on the suitcase that got lost.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を had put と過去完了に

ja: 私たち、もう少し早くホテルを出ていれば、空港行きのバスに乗り遅れなかったのに。
en: If we had left the hotel a bit earlier, we wouldn't have missed the airport bus.
alternatives: If we'd left the hotel a little earlier, we wouldn't have missed the bus to the airport.
We wouldn't have missed the airport bus if we had left the hotel a bit sooner.
point: 過去の後悔は if 節を had left、主節を wouldn't have missed に

ja: 空港のスタッフに、私のスーツケースを次の便で送ってくれるよう頼んでくれない？
en: Can you ask the airport staff to send my suitcase on the next flight?
alternatives: Could you ask the airport staff to put my suitcase on the next flight?
Can you get the airport staff to send my suitcase on the next flight?
point: 「〜するよう頼む」は ask＋人＋to do。人のあとに to 不定詞

ja: 財布をなくしてしまいました。何かアドバイスをもらえますか？
en: I lost my wallet. Can I get some advice?
alternatives: I've lost my wallet. Could you give me some advice?
I lost my wallet. Do you have any advice?
point: advice は数えられないので an advice ではなく some advice

ja: この部屋、予約した部屋よりずっと狭いんですが。
en: This room is much smaller than the one I booked.
alternatives: This room is a lot smaller than the room I booked.
This room is much smaller than the one I reserved.
point: 比較級の強調は very ではなく much

ja: タクシーを待っていた時に、パスポートがないことに気づいたんです。
en: I was waiting for a taxi when I noticed my passport was missing.
alternatives: While I was waiting for a taxi, I noticed my passport was gone.
I realized my passport was missing while I was waiting for a taxi.
point: 「待っていた最中」は過去進行形 was waiting

ja: 電車で私の前に座っていた男の人が、私のバッグを持って行ったのかもしれません。
en: The man sitting in front of me on the train may have taken my bag.
alternatives: The man who was sitting in front of me on the train might have taken my bag.
The man seated in front of me on the train might have taken my bag.
point: sitting で後ろから man を説明し、過去の推量は may have done

ja: 昨日カメラを盗まれたんですが、まだ警察には届けていないんです。
en: My camera was stolen yesterday, but I haven't reported it to the police yet.
alternatives: Someone stole my camera yesterday, but I haven't reported it to the police yet.
I had my camera stolen yesterday, but I still haven't reported it to the police.
point: yesterday は過去形、まだ〜していないは現在完了

ja: 私たち、スーツケースが出てくるのをもう2時間も待っているんです。
en: We've been waiting for our suitcases to come out for two hours now.
alternatives: We've been waiting two hours for our suitcases to come out.
We've been waiting for our luggage to come out for two hours already.
point: 今も待ち続けているので have been waiting を使う

ja: カメラを盗まれたので、保険のためにホテルに報告書を作ってもらいたいんですが。
en: My camera was stolen, so I'd like to have the hotel prepare a report for my insurance.
alternatives: Since my camera was stolen, I'd like to get the hotel to write a report for my insurance.
My camera got stolen, so I'd like the hotel to prepare a report for my insurance claim.
point: have + 人 + 原形、get なら get + 人 + to do

ja: 彼女は明日、警察にバッグの盗難届を出すつもりです。
en: She's going to report her stolen bag to the police tomorrow.
alternatives: She'll report her stolen bag to the police tomorrow.
She's going to report her bag stolen to the police tomorrow.
point: 予定は be going to、「盗まれたバッグ」は stolen bag
